test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly knows facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some parks are fields.

Some fields are houses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some houses are parks.

II. Some fields are parks.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8759ad2b93dbb3fb877ae343eb26676d8417f3bf5719dbf57a625c5ff6f7337d.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some houses are parks
